title: Build the DHQG 2024 hybrid report pack in the new layout from the t81 runs (REQ-0094)
acceptance_criteria: AC1 pack at $0, every md has a pdf, checker passes (keyless pack accepted)
AC2 all-subjects solution-report 120/120 with question text, no raw JSON doubt lines
AC3 reply names each file and kind; old solutions.md = solution-report
AC4 corrected 64-67 (t82) not merged; note says which run

design.summary: build the DHQG 2024 pack from plans/dhqg2024/t81/runs with the existing report-pack command at $0, keyless, md+pdf, checker, one run (t82 corrections stay a note)

implementation.summary: python3 -I scripts/exam.py report-pack on the four t81 plan runs (--exam dhqg2024 --run t81) wrote reports/dhqg2024/t81/run-20261108-055609 (31 files + INDEX.md + run.json), $0

unit_test.command: python3 -I tools/check_report_pack.py reports/dhqg2024/t81/run-20261108-055609 + 4 plan dirs; recount of questions/options/raw JSON
unit_test.result: checker 53 checks 0 failed (keyless pack accepted); 120/120 questions with A-D options in the all-subjects solution-report, 0 raw level JSON lines; per-subject headings equal result.json questions (20/20/30/50); md-with-pdf pairs 9 = 9

security.result: deterministic report from stored results; no AI call, no shell, no key (keyless pack); legacy folders untouched

verification.command: python3 -I scripts/exam.py report-pack (4 t81 plan runs); tools/check_report_pack.py; recount; sha256 of result.json vs run.json; legacy mtime check
verification.result: pack reports/dhqg2024/t81/run-20261108-055609: checker 53 checks 0 failed; 9 md = 9 pdf; 120/120 questions with text and options; 0 raw level JSON; answered 19/18/25/49 = 111, declined 9; run.json result_sha256 equal for the 4 plan runs; legacy runs unchanged; printed 64-67 are declined in the t81 run (the t82 re-solve answers D, A, D, B): stated in the report and to the user, not merged (one run per pack); 'none' wording token is a recorded follow-up

quality.reason: pack recounted independently (questions, options, answers, md=pdf pairs) and result hashes recomputed from the real plan files

designer.waiver: run of an existing command, design written by main

coder.waiver: no code change: existing report-pack command

tester.waiver: no code: the checker and a recount are the tests

user_notes.note: pack for DHQG 2024 in the new layout; one run t81; corrected 64-67 stay a note
